youtube.baslik: Does tinnitus really start in the ear? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Tinnitus often arises from the brain's response to reduced input from the cochlea: the central auditory pathways turn up their sensitivity. Tinnitus can persist even in people whose auditory nerve has been cut, so it is described as a kind of phantom auditory perception.

instagram.kanca: Does tinnitus really start in the ear?
bilgiler: When the cochlea is damaged, input to the brain drops.
Central pathways raise their sensitivity; sound is heard when none exists.
Tinnitus is a kind of phantom auditory perception.
